Ineos suspends UK chemical plant production due to high gas prices

Ineos has suspended production at key chemical plants in the UK, citing high natural gas prices. The company stated that natural gas in the UK is twelve times more expensive than in the US. As a result, Ineos will mothball three chemical plants.
